label: Livability score (0-100)
source: Composite of six GeoStats layers: walkability, public transport coverage, healthcare accessibility, green space per capita (OSM, Aug 2026); DSIB school rating (2022/23); traffic-incident safety (Dubai Police)
period: 2022-2026 (components: OSM Aug-2026 snapshot, KHDA 2022/23, Dubai Police incidents)
method: Each component is converted to a percentile rank across communities that have it (safety inverted so fewer incidents ranks higher). The score is the unweighted mean of the available percentiles. Communities with fewer than 4 of the 6 components are null.
limitation: Relative ranking within Dubai, not an absolute standard. Density-driven components (transport, healthcare, walkability per km2) favour older, denser districts. Component coverage varies, so scores built on 4 components are less stable than those on 6.
